innovation_summary: openai-reasoning-kv-sentinel is a reasoning-workload monitor focused on KV-cache behaviour, long-context efficiency, and anomaly detection in OpenAI-style model serving — the sentinel that watches the cache rather than the model. Its portfolio thesis is that long-context reasoning degrades through cache pressure and eviction pathologies long before output quality visibly breaks, so the observable to instrument is KV occupancy and reuse, not token latency. It is the canonical head of the largest company family in the estate (22 repositories, of which 18 are reference or historical), which makes it the single original engineering exhibit standing in front of a large forked-and-vendored OpenAI surface — and the family's stated priority is precisely 'P0 provenance and Codex audit', i.e. proving which work is authored versus adopted.
